reason: It's end of October, nothing is on fire, and our Excel sheets and fee register are working well enough for now. I'd look at the exam-centre module in January when the CBSE centre work starts to hurt, not sign up for all 14 modules today.
objection: I already pay for some software or manage in Excel, and moving fees and student data to a new company I've never heard of means my staff learning everything again. If it breaks in March in the middle of board exams, who do I call?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the seating plan, invigilator duty and Form 66 part work on my own centre's data, plus a school near me that ran its board exam centre on it without trouble.
